text.description_html:
Cal-Royal ESC45-40 Dummy Lever Trim for Panic Device

This Narrow Escutcheon Plate Dummy Function Lever (Lever rigid, used as pull only. ANSI Function 02) is suitable for all Narrow or Wide Stile Doors (aluminum framed, hollow metal, or wood). For use on door's exterior with Crossbar Narrow Stile Surface Vertical Rod Exit Device. Heavy duty surface vertical rod panic device for narrow stiles.

Packaged with mounting hardware and installation instructions.

Also Available Matching: Entry Lever, Passage Lever, and Storeroom Lever

Features for CAL-ESC45-40 Dummy Lever

  • Dummy Function (ANSI F02 - Lever rigid, used as pull only.
  • Base Material: Steel with Aluminum Alloy Escutcheon Trim
  • Escutcheon Plate Width: 1-13/16"
  • Escutcheon Plate Height: 8-3/4"
  • Total Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Lever Length: 5"
  • Non-Handed
  • Rigid
  • Grade 1
  • ADA Compliant
  • Installation Instructions (PDF)
